content: View Transitions API (same-document/SPA form) is NOT yet Baseline widely-available: supported in Chrome 111+, Edge, Safari; Firefox support only landed in v144 (beta as of source date). MDN/web.dev explicitly recommend a non-transitioned fallback path since support is inconsistent. Given this project has no cross-browser requirement (single local file, author-controlled browser) it *could* be used opportunistically, but CSS transitions/WAAPI cover the same board redraw-animation needs without the same-document caveat, so View Transitions is not necessary and adds an unverified-everywhere dependency for no unique benefit here.
